summary.intent: Run the GSD plan-phase workflow for phase 59 (fuse-ipns-verify-publish-hardening-and-cleanup) to produce executable PLAN.md files with integrated research and verification.
summary.outcome: Research, pattern mapping, and planning completed with 4 plans across 4 waves. A plan-checker blocker (unresolved Open Questions markers in RESEARCH.md) and warning (stub VALIDATION.md table) were fixed inline; checker re-run is pending confirmation of clean pass.

repo: Phase 59 is keyed to requirement HARD-10 and covers six durability-critical FUSE Rust files with pre-existing todo writeups in .planning/todos/pending/

The TEE re-sign risk (Finding F in research) is NOT present — the TEE republish path bypasses the embedded-sequence gate entirely, making the unify-to-embed=1 change a cleanup rather than a security fix
API surface extraction (TypeScript extractor) produces empty output for Rust-only phases and should be omitted as a planner hint in those cases
GSD planner creates a stray docs/plan-phase-<N> branch when it commits; the commit helper auto-switches main to feat/<slug>; consolidation onto feat/ branch is always needed post-planning
PATTERNS.md written by gsd-pattern-mapper is never committed by any plan-phase step — it becomes an untracked orphan unless explicitly added
workflow: gsd-planner stray branch gotcha: docs/plan-phase-<N> fast-forwards cleanly onto feat/<slug> when the feat branch is the planner's parent commit; safe to rebase and delete stray
Plan-checker doc-level blockers (missing RESOLVED markers, stub tables) are cheaper to fix inline than to re-spawn the full planner
auto_chain_active flag in phase frontmatter must be cleared on manual invocations to prevent unintended auto-advance behavior
RESEARCH.md Open Questions section requires explicit (RESOLVED) markers with citations to adopting plan actions to pass the plan-checker gate

friction: gsd-planner created a stray docs/plan-phase-59 branch instead of committing directly to feat/<slug>, requiring manual branch consolidation
PATTERNS.md has no commit step in the plan-phase workflow, leaving it as an untracked orphan after the pattern-mapper subagent runs
commit helper emits a known false-negative 'commit_failed' even when the commit lands successfully, causing confusion when verifying git state

Plan-checker flagged RESEARCH.md Open Questions as a blocker even though both questions were already answered in the plans — the marker format is a mechanical requirement not enforced earlier in the flow
open_items: Plan-checker re-run (iteration 2/3) was pending at transcript end — clean pass not yet confirmed
